decisions.reason: As a multi-model line with its own web presence in 2018 and 2019, this looks like a meaningful engineering investment that management is likely to continue supporting unless evidence of failure becomes unmistakable.

A floor-level shower drainage system fits directly with the firm's stated move toward integrated, accessible, low-profile bathroom solutions, so management has strong strategic and sunk-cost reasons to persist.

Because the firm publicly framed this designer shower drainage line as a flagship for its future direction, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal especially unlikely despite any mixed early results.
This shower element supports installation ease and renovation use cases that are central to the firm's positioning, so management would likely view any weaker performance as temporary and retain it.

Although somewhat less central than shower-focused products, it was visibly launched and promoted as a developed solution to a specific drainage problem, which gives management reasons to justify keeping it on the market.
With only limited website visibility and a weaker connection to the firm's core shower-drainage direction, this line is the easiest for management to discontinue and redirect resources away from.
